title: A coefficient-compatible etale presentation of a strict localization
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $Y$ a finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $y=s(\operatorname{closedPoint}\Omega)$ and $B=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,s}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. There exist an affine open $U$ containing $y$, a separably closed extension $L/K$ with $\operatorname{trdeg}_K L=\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(y)$ [def-kun-separably-closed], [def-kun-transcendence-degree], [def-weil-residue-field], a commutative domain $R$, compatible $R$- and $\operatorname{Frac}(R)$-algebra structures on $L$ with $L/\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ algebraic, and a ring map $r:R\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. In addition there exist a small filtered category $I$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a diagram $E:I\to (\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)\downarrow\mathbf{CRing})$, a cocone $c$, a ring map $h:L\to c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{right}$, and an isomorphism $e:\operatorname{Spec}B\cong\operatorname{Spec}(c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{right})$. The underlying ring cocone is colimiting and its vertex is nonzero. The composite of $e$, $\operatorname{Spec}(c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{hom})$, the affine-spectrum identification [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $U\hookrightarrow Y$ is the canonical structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. The composites $R\xrightarrow r\Gamma(U)\to c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{right}$ and $K\to\Gamma(U)\to c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{right}$ agree respectively with $R\to L\xrightarrow h c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{right}$ and $K\to L\xrightarrow h c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{right}$. For every $i$, $\operatorname{Spec}(E_i.\mathrm{hom})$ is étale. Algebraic means each element satisfies a nonzero polynomial, and $\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ is the fraction field of the domain $R$.

proof.text: Choose U,L,R,r,a,h from the coefficient-chart theorem. The map Spec Gamma(U)→Y is the affine chart. The displayed structural-map equation supplies the compatibility required by strictHenselization_indEtale_of_affine_chart, with A=B and the identity spectrum isomorphism. Thus a is ind-etale.

proof.text: Unpack RingHom.IndEtale.iff_exists into a small filtered ring diagram D, maps t_i:Gamma(U)→D_i, a colimit cocone b_i:D_i→B, and the equations t_i;b_i=a. Regard D as a diagram E in Under Gamma(U), and the same cocone as a cocone c of E with vertex a. Forgetting under-objects recovers the given ring colimit definitionally. The identity spectrum isomorphism preserves the structural map and all scalar equations. Each t_i is etale by the affine spectrum criterion.

theorem exists_strictLocal_coefficient_presentation
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of K))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ U ∧
      ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen U,
      ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L) (_ : IsSepClosed L),
        Algebra.trdeg K L =
          @Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) _ _
            (((Y ↘ Spec (.of K)).residueFieldAlgebraMap
              (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))).toAlgebra) ∧
        ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : IsDomain R)
          (_ : Algebra R L) (_ : Algebra (FractionRing R) L)
          (_ : IsScalarTower R (FractionRing R) L)
          (_ : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (FractionRing R) L)
          (r : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤))
          (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
          (E : I ⥤ Under Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)) (c : Cocone E)
          (h : L →+* c.pt.right)
          (e : strictHenselizationScheme s ≅ Spec c.pt.right),
          Nonempty (IsColimit ((Under.forget _).mapCocone c)) ∧
          Nontrivial c.pt.right ∧
          e.hom ≫ Spec.map c.pt.hom ≫ (@Scheme.isoSpec U.toScheme hU).inv ≫ U.ι =
            strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ∧
          r ≫ c.pt.hom = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom h ∧
          (ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ (U.ι ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))).appTop ≫ c.pt.hom =
            CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom h ∧
          ∀ i : I, Etale (Spec.map (E.obj i).hom)
